The main takeaway from our work is that
the IRRC is strongly M$_{*}$ and redshift-dependent.
the radio SFR indicator is not universal, and it is not even universal in the IR, as the radio-to-IR luminosity ratio depends on M$_{*}$ and z.
radio emission is not only a powerful tool to trace SFR in star-forming systems, but it can also be used as a tracer of M$_{*}$.
